sentences.text: As per the case of the prosecution, on 26.06.2024 at about 07:30 pm at T-86, Kallu Ka Makan, Near Axis Bank ATM, Biryani Chowk, Sarai Kale Khan, Delhi, within the jurisdiction of PS Sunlight Colony, accused Inder Pal was filling gas in the cylinder without having any license in that behalf and thereby, the accused acted rashly and negligently with respect to combustible matter by failing to take such order as is sufficient to guard against any probable danger to human life.
Thereby, it is the case of the prosecution that the accused has committed offence punishable u/s 285 IPC.
3. Thereafter, chargesheet was filed and the accused was summoned for trial.

Vide order dated 17.12.2024, accused was served with notice under Section 251 Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (CrPC) for the offence punishable U/s 285 IPC to which he pleaded not guilty and claimed trial.

4. Prosecution has examined one (01) witness to prove its case against the accused as under:
4.1 PW-1 HC Satish Chand deposed that on 26.06.2024, he alongwith Ct. Mahipal was on patrolling duty.
At about 07:30 PM, he reached at the spot i.e. T-86, Kallu Ka Makan, Near Axis Bank ATM, Biryani Chowk, Sarai Kale Khan, Delhi.
Therefore, they saw a person who was in his shop and filling the LPG in small gas cylinder without having license.
They asked the accused to produce the license about the same but he failed to produce the license.

Thereafter, he had taken the photographs of State Vs.
Inder Pal, FIR No.216/2024, PS Sunlight Colony Page No. 2 of 4 the spot and informed the SHO about the same and the SHO directed him to take the action as per law.
After ascertaining the circumstances and evaluating the spot, he was satisfied that the case u/s 285 IPC was made out.
Thereafter, he prepared a tehrir (Ex.PW1/A).
The tehrir was sent for registration of FIR and on the basis of which, the case was registered.
Thereafter, he prepared the site plan (Ex.PW1/B).
He had recorded the statement of police official u/s 161 CrPC.
Thereafter, the accused was interrogated and arrested vide arrest memo Ex.PW1/C.
Thereafter, he prepared the chargesheet and filed it before the Hon'ble Court.

He correctly identified the accused as well as the photographs of the spot [Ex.P-1 (colly)].
5.

Vide order dated 17.12.2024, the accused has admitted certain documents which are Ex.PA-1 (colly) to Ex.PA-2 vide statement of accused was recorded u/s 294 CrPC and witnesses qua these documents were dropped by the prosecution.

6. After prosecution evidence, on 10.02.2025, the statement of the accused was recorded under Section 313 CrPC after putting all the incriminating evidence against him, he stated that he is not guilty of the aforesaid offence and it is further stated that he opted not to lead any defence evidence.
7.
I have heard the final arguments put forth by the APP for the state and by the accused.
I have also perused the materials available on record.

sentences.text: In order to prove allegations against the accused regarding State Vs. Inder Pal, FIR No.216/2024, PS Sunlight Colony Page No. 3 of 4 commission of offence punishable u/s 285 IPC, PW-1 deposed that on 26.06.2024 at about 07:30 PM, during patrolling duty, he reached at the spot i.e. T-86, Kallu Ka Makan, Near Axis Bank ATM, Biryani Chowk, Sarai Kale Khan, Delhi.
Therefore, they saw a person who was in his shop and filling the LPG in small gas cylinder without having license.
He asked the accused to produce the license about the same but he failed to produce the license.
Further, the accused did not cross examine the witness despite given opportunity and the accused took the defence only that he is not guilty for the alleged offence.
The accused did not lead defence evidence.
He also could not produce any proof regarding non-filling of LPG.
The prosecution has been able to discharge the burden beyond reasonable doubt.
The court is of the considered view that allegation against the accused regarding commission of offence punishable u/s 285 IPC is proved beyond reasonable doubt.
Hence, accused Inder Pal is convicted for the said offence.
Announced in the open court today on 10th February, 2025.
